Fonts bundled for the Expressive and Comfort styles
====================================================

app/src/main/res/font/google_sans_flex.ttf
  Google Sans Flex, from github.com/google/fonts, ofl/googlesansflex
  ("GoogleSansFlex[ROND,opsz,slnt,wdth,wght].ttf", upstream v5.000,
  github.com/googlefonts/googlesans-flex). Copyright 2015 The Google Sans Flex Authors.
  Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1: see OFL-google-sans-flex.txt. The licence
  names no Reserved Font Name. "Google", "Google Sans" and "Google Sans Flex" are trademarks
  of Google LLC; Attic uses the font only and claims no affiliation with Google.

  Modified (subset) with fontTools 4.60:
    python3 -m fontTools.varLib.instancer GoogleSansFlex.ttf \
        slnt=0 wght=300:800 wdth=50:100 opsz=12:48 -o inst.ttf
    python3 -m fontTools.subset inst.ttf --unicodes=<Basic Latin, Latin-1, Latin Extended-A,
        U+0300-0303, U+0308, general punctuation, € ™ ← → − × ·> \
        --layout-features='kern,liga,calt,ccmp,locl,mark,mkmk,tnum,pnum,lnum,case' \
        --no-hinting --desubroutinize --output-file=google_sans_flex.ttf
  The slant axis is pinned upright and the ranges narrowed to what the app sets. Characters
  outside the subset fall back to the system font.

app/src/main/res/font/material_symbols_rounded.ttf
  Material Symbols Rounded, from github.com/google/material-design-icons,
  variablefont/MaterialSymbolsRounded[FILL,GRAD,opsz,wght].ttf. Copyright Google LLC.
  Licensed under the Apache License 2.0: see LICENSE-material-symbols.txt.

  Modified (subset) with fontTools 4.60 to the 88 icons the Expressive and Comfort designs use,
  listed with their codepoints in app/src/main/java/app/attic/player/ui/expressive/Symbols.kt:
    python3 -m fontTools.varLib.instancer MaterialSymbolsRounded.ttf \
        GRAD=0 opsz=20:48 wght=300:700 -o inst.ttf
    python3 -m fontTools.subset inst.ttf --unicodes=<the codepoints in Symbols.kt> \
        --layout-features='' --no-hinting --desubroutinize --output-file=material_symbols_rounded.ttf
  Grade is pinned at 0; the fill, weight and optical-size axes are kept. Ligatures are dropped:
  the app addresses each icon by codepoint. Expressive draws at weight 400, Comfort at 300.

app/src/main/res/font/onest.ttf
  Onest, from github.com/google/fonts, ofl/onest ("Onest[wght].ttf", upstream v2.001,
  github.com/simpals/onest). Copyright 2021 The Onest Project Authors. Licensed under the
  SIL Open Font License 1.1: see OFL-onest.txt. The licence names no Reserved Font Name.
  Used by the Comfort style.

  Modified (subset) with fontTools 4.60:
    python3 -m fontTools.varLib.instancer "Onest[wght].ttf" wght=400:800 -o inst.ttf
    python3 -m fontTools.subset inst.ttf \
        --unicodes="U+0020-007E,U+00A0-00FF,U+0100-017F,U+0300-0303,U+0308,U+2000-206F,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2190,U+2192,U+2212" \
        --layout-features='kern,liga,calt,ccmp,locl,mark,mkmk,tnum,pnum,lnum,case' \
        --no-hinting --desubroutinize --output-file=onest.ttf
  The weight axis is narrowed to the 400-800 the kit sets and the characters to Latin.
  Cyrillic and other scripts fall back to the system font.
